analysis:
The supplied units are CHANGELOG.md head text at lines 1008-1448, and the patch excerpt is truncated and covers only the new v0.10.1 candidate header and rollout notes. The changed ranges are documentation only: head 11-100. Everything in the supplied units (lines 1008-1448) lies outside the changed range and is pre-existing release history. I found no executable code, configuration, workflow or permission changes in what was supplied.

The new v0.10.1 rollout notes visible in the patch excerpt carry security-relevant claims that I could not verify. They say a coordinator must include darkbloom-platform#411 to refuse `logprobs` on GLM-5.3-Flash, MiMo V2.6 and Nemotron 3.5 Super before reservation. They say an older provider fails such a request with a 500 `generation_failure` that cools every provider of the model. That would be an availability risk for T-010 or the provider-health surfaces if an adversarial consumer sends logprobs to a coordinator without the gate. The backend is out of scope here and platform-owned, so this is documented as a deployment prerequisite, not a regression in this repository. I cannot confirm the coordinator's behavior from the supplied evidence.

The notes also say page-cache accounting changes load admission, KV budgets and cold-load capacity for every model, so more memory may be counted as available than in 0.10.0. That could affect memory-pressure and availability assumptions (TB-007, T-029), but the implementing source files were not supplied. They also say `libs/mlx-swift-lm` moves from 7bed8216 to 6148b6da. The SDK source diff and that submodule's contents were not supplied, so the dependency change is unreviewed.

T-041 and the cache-routing text in the unchanged historical changelog sections match the canonical context and show no new at-rest, TTL or scoping change in the supplied lines. The remaining integration questions are the actual Swift changes behind the page-cache accounting, the GLM variable-frame-rate video handling and its media size limits, and the logprobs gate. Those need source review in other batches.
